title: Phase 3 execution, Layer 3: round 6 — verify the round-5 fixes, re-decide the stop

comments.author: xqjG
comments.content: DISPATCH MANIFEST (declared before the spend). invoked_by: operator decision at round 5 (fix + verify). vehicle: the Workflow surface (background; resume net). round shape: STOP-DECIDING VERIFY over the round-5 change set (52f94321): the default-ignorable range extension, the state-source cleaning covering the machine form, the broken machine block, the post_load wiring pin, the composition post_load, and the added #789 falsifier. THREE lenses: security (does the char class now truly close — any invisible/spoofing code point still passing, is the Unassigned-range gate correct across the reserved set, does the machine form now hold under hostile state AND hostile diagnostic), software-engineer (the read_state cleaning's correctness and its effect on the #749 verbatim echo and gate-matching logic; the broken machine block; the composition post_load; regressions), quality-engineer (do ALL round-5 falsifiers falsify — the range unit pins, the machine-form test, the wiring load-through, the hostile-path pin, the composition clean; is any claimed test actually absent again — explicitly re-check every test named in the #798-#801 closes exists and bites). If it finds another real major, that is strong signal to pause and reassess scope with the operator rather than continue. comments.author: xqjG
comments.content: ROUND 6 RETURNED — 2 of 3 lenses (the quality lens died mid-response on a connection drop, the 4th interruption of this layer's dispatches; a dead lens is not a clean verdict, so it needs a cached re-run, but the security lens already refuses the stop). Verdicts: #798/#800/#801 held; #799 incomplete. Stop: NOT reached. Children: #803 (major security: active_composition.config_inputs_hash — the FOURTH ActiveComposition string field — is uncleaned at read_state and serialized raw into the machine form; #799 cleaned scope, domains, and phase and missed this sibling; demonstrated on the built binary with U+202E/U+200B/U+2060/tag/U+E0000 all reaching machine-form stdout), #804 (minor security+SE convergent: assigned default-ignorable Hangul fillers U+115F/1160/3164/FFA0, category Lo, are invisible in common terminal fonts but pass the Cc/Cf/Zl/Zp+unassigned filter — the only default-ignorable survivors outside a declared preservation decision), #805 (nit collector: comparison-only state fields uncleaned, intra-state asymmetry, broken human machine_token raw). TELEMETRY: 235,560 tokens across the 2 completed lenses; chosen=observed fable, security/SE high. CONVERGENCE ASSESSMENT, honest: this is the THIRD 'N-1 of N' occurrence — chars (enumerated, missed members), registry strings (cleaned 2, found 4 more), now composition fields (cleaned 3, missed 1). The member-by-member fixing does not converge because I keep hand-picking which fields to clean. There IS a systematic fix that converges by construction (recursively sanitize the machine-form JSON output, catching every field regardless of struct shape), but that is an architectural choice. Per the round-6 manifest's pre-commitment — another real major means pause and reassess scope with the operator, not continue — I am NOT dispatching round 7. Surfacing the decision to the operator with the systematic option as the recommendation. #803's one-line field fix is trivial; the question is whether to do the systematic fix that ends the class or make a scope call.

comments.author: xqjG
comments.content: ROUND 6 DISPOSITION + PHASE-3 LOOP SUSPENDED (under the #806 ratification). Round 6's findings are ROUTED, not fixed-in-place: #803/#804/#805 all route to the Phase 1a/1b terminal-safety spec amendment (routing plans recorded on each). The phase-3 loop for Layer 3 is SUSPENDED here — it was not converging by member-fixing because it was patching an UNSPECIFIED requirement (six rounds, spec unchanged, code churned: the collapse #806 names). It does not resume as more phase-3 rounds; it resumes as: (a) the terminal-safety spec amendment specifies the requirement, mechanism (Default_Ignorable UCD property), boundary (vsdd-local now + shared-primitive raise to crosslink), and systematic sink (recursive machine-form sanitization); (b) a minimal rebuild under the spec — keep the recursive JSON sanitizer, DISCARD the uncommitted round-6 Hangul enumeration (the UCD property retires it), swap the predicate; (c) ONE verify round against the now-specified requirement; (d) Layer 3 close. The falsifiability findings from earlier rounds that were fix-closed stand; the round-6 uncommitted edits are held pending the amendment. RETROSPECTIVE NOTE: rounds 1-5's terminal-safety fixes are real and landed (they close genuine injection vulnerabilities) but were built without a governing spec — the amendment supplies the spec they should have had, and their tests become its verification architecture. This is the routing that should have happened at round 1.

comments.author: xqjG

Then step (c) one verify round against the now-specified requirement, step (d) Layer 3 close. Awaiting operator direction to enter the rebuild (phase-2 execution).
